in_marathi.name: Nurjamal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Light of the moon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Nurjamal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Nurjamal is derived from the combination of two words: Nur and Jamal. Nur means 'light' and Jamal means 'moon'. Thus, the name Nurjamal translates to 'Light of the moon'. This name is believed to be associated with the Hindu deity, Krishna, who is often depicted with a moon on his forehead.
